## What changed

Describe the user outcome, not only the implementation.

## Quality evidence

- [ ] Unit or Rust tests cover domain rules and failure paths.
- [ ] Widget tests cover meaningful UI states and interactions.
- [ ] Integration tests cover critical boundaries where appropriate.
- [ ] A user-testing scenario was added or updated for any user-facing change.
- [ ] Accessibility, privacy, offline behavior, and recovery were considered.
- [ ] No personal transcript, audio, or raw user-testing notes are included.

## User validation

List the scenario IDs run, the platforms used, and any sanitized issues found. If user validation is deferred, explain why and identify the release gate that will require it.
